a.t-if: sale_order.state in ('sale', 'done') and sale_order._is_paid() and not sale_order.order_line.filtered(lambda line: line.qty_delivered > 0) and not sale_order.b2b_change_request_ids.filtered(lambda change: change.state in ('submitted', 'under_review', 'customer_confirmation', 'balance_due', 'finance_review', 'applying'))

xpath.attribute: sale_order.b2b_review_state != 'pending' and (sale_order._has_to_be_paid() or (payment_amount and sale_order.amount_paid < sale_order.amount_total and sale_order.state != 'cancel'))
